text:
alexa.support: Customer reported streaming responses cut the tool_call args in half. they send a tool call with nested JSON and the stream ends with a partial object, e.g.

alexa.support: example partial payload seen in client logs:
```json
{"tool":"create_invoice","args":{"customer_id":"cus_123","items":[{"sku":"SKU-1","qty":1},{"sku":"SKU-2","qty":2}],"billing_address":{"line1":"123 Main St","city":"Oakland","state":"CA","zip":"94
```

alexa.support: request_id=rid_0a1b2c3d, client sdk=js-sdk@2.4.1, medium=server-sent-events, origin=customer-proxy

maria.cs: thanks — can you paste full headers + the minimal repro curl? also which SDK version / proxy?

alexa.support: headers:
```
Accept: text/event-stream
Connection: keep-alive
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
User-Agent: RedwoodJS/2.4.1
X-Request-Id: rid_0a1b2c3d
```

alexa.support: repro curl (from customer):
```bash
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"x-stream-1","input":"call tool","stream":true,"tool_call":true,"tool_payload": {"tool":"create_invoice","args": {"customer_id":"cus_123","items":[{"sku":"SKU-1","qty":1},{"sku":"SKU-2","qty":2}],"billing_address": {"line1":"123 Main St","city":"Oakland","state":"CA","zip":"94107"}}}}' \
  https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate
```

chris.qa: I can repro locally if I proxy via nginx with chunk_size 512 and proxy_buffering off. looks like a chunk boundary falls inside a multibyte sequence for the zip string and the client concatenation shows an unterminated JSON.

sam.eng-runtime: can you paste our runtime logs for rid_0a1b2c3d? looking for "incomplete_json" or "partial_tool_args" markers.

alexa.support: paste from api logs (redacted):
```
[2024-06-03T15:12:01.234Z] INFO request start rid=rid_0a1b2c3d user=cus_abc
[2024-06-03T15:12:01.305Z] DEBUG sse chunk sent bytes=512
[2024-06-03T15:12:01.306Z] DEBUG sse chunk sent bytes=210
[2024-06-03T15:12:01.307Z] ERROR parser incomplete_json rid=rid_0a1b2c3d offset=722 expected=']' got=EOF
[2024-06-03T15:12:01.308Z] WARN fallback invoked rid=rid_0a1b2c3d route=tool-fallback
```

sam.eng-runtime: interesting — runtime parsed chunks correctly but parser saw EOF before JSON closed. two hypotheses: 1) intermediary proxy is trimming trailing bytes on chunk boundary (nginx bug with proxy_buffering + gzip), or 2) client SSE lib is dropping trailing CRLF when reassembling. can you ask for gateway logs showing Content-Length or chunk sizes?

maria.cs: customer says they upgraded their proxy yesterday (cloudflare worker + custom transform). they can try bypassing the worker for a test.

chris.qa: quick repro script to test reassembly (node):
```js
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
(async () => {
  const r = await fetch('https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate', {headers:{'Accept':'text/event-stream'}, method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload)});
  r.body.on('data', chunk => process.stdout.write(chunk));
})();
```

chris.qa: if you see broken JSON, try run with --max-http-header-size larger or set proxy chunk size to 1k.

sam.eng-runtime: actionable next steps:
- ask customer to bypass cloudflare worker (quick toggle) and repro.
- capture tcpdump on their proxy to confirm chunk boundaries.
- we can add server-side mitigation: emit a small "chunk-safe" marker before tool_call args so reassembly tolerates boundaries.
- short-term workaround: have client base64-encode the tool args or send tool args as single-line (no multibyte sequences near end).

alexa.support: customer will try bypass and report. asked them to include tcpdump, headers, and the raw SSE stream.

maria.cs: escalate to enterprise success — this affects Dedicated customers behind managed proxies. flagging for P1 if repro confirmed.

deploy-bot: scheduled patch pipeline for branch "sse-reassembly-guard" created by @sam.eng-runtime — CI triggered.

sam.eng-runtime: I'll prototype an "sse reassembly guard" that emits a zero-width separator before large JSON arguments and a checksum trailer. if we ship, clients won't need to change.

alexa.support: thanks everyone — closing loop once customer confirms bypass test. will ping #incidents if we see other customers. :thumbsup:
